parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const crypto=require('crypto');const input=$input.first()?.json||{};const text=(v,n=0)=>{const s=String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').trim();return n?s.slice(0,n):s};const operation=text(input.operation).toLowerCase();if(!['export','delete_preview','delete_confirm'].includes(operation))throw new Error('privacy_request_invalid_operation');const principalKey=text(input.principalKey,100);if(!/^tgactor_[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(principalKey))throw new Error('privacy_request_invalid_principal');const telegramActorId=text(input.telegramActorId,32);if(telegramActorId&&!/^\d+$/.test(telegramActorId))throw new Error('privacy_request_invalid_actor');const requestId=text(input.requestId,160)||`privacy_${principalKey.slice(0,32)}_${Date.now()}`;if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,160}$/.test(requestId))throw new Error('privacy_request_invalid_request_id');const expectedToken=`delete:${requestId}:${principalKey.slice(-12)}`;const supplied=text(input.confirmationToken,240);const destructive=operation==='delete_confirm';const hash=s=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s,'utf8').digest('hex');if(destructive&&hash(supplied)!==hash(expectedToken))throw new Error('privacy_request_confirmation_mismatch');return [{json:{operation,principalKey,telegramActorId,requestId,dryRun:!destructive,confirmationTokenHash:destructive?hash(supplied):'',destructiveAllowed:destructive,expectedConfirmationToken:operation==='delete_preview'?expectedToken:'',requestedAt:new Date().toISOString(),privacySchemaVersion:'chelsea_privacy_request_v5'}}];
